import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest

from payhook.config import load_config

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))


def write_env(text):
    handle, path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".env")
    with os.fdopen(handle, "w") as f:
        f.write(text)
    return path


class ConfigTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_quoted_values(self):
        path = write_env('PAYHOOK_REGION="us"\nPAYHOOK_TIMEOUT=\'20\'\n')
        config = load_config(environ={}, dotenv_path=path)
        self.assertEqual(config["PAYHOOK_REGION"], ("us", ".env"))
        self.assertEqual(config["PAYHOOK_TIMEOUT"], ("20", ".env"))

    def test_export_prefix_and_equals_in_value(self):
        path = write_env("export PAYHOOK_ENDPOINT=https://x.example/?a=1&b=2\n")
        config = load_config(environ={}, dotenv_path=path)
        self.assertEqual(config["PAYHOOK_ENDPOINT"], ("https://x.example/?a=1&b=2", ".env"))

    def test_environment_wins(self):
        path = write_env("PAYHOOK_REGION=us\n")
        config = load_config(environ={"PAYHOOK_REGION": "ap"}, dotenv_path=path)
        self.assertEqual(config["PAYHOOK_REGION"], ("ap", "env"))

    def test_doctor_lists_every_setting(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            result = subprocess.run(
                [sys.executable, "-m", "payhook", "doctor"],
                cwd=tmp, capture_output=True, text=True,
                env={**os.environ, "PYTHONPATH": ROOT, "PAYHOOK_REGION": "us"},
            )
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        for key in ("PAYHOOK_API_TOKEN", "PAYHOOK_WEBHOOK_SECRET", "PAYHOOK_ENDPOINT", "PAYHOOK_TIMEOUT", "PAYHOOK_REGION"):
            self.assertIn(key, result.stdout)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

| `PAYHOOK_REGION` | `eu` |

`.env` uses the usual dotenv syntax: `KEY=value`, optional single or double quotes around the value, an optional leading `export `, and `#` comment lines.

from tests.test_config import ROOT, write_env


class DotenvSyntaxTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_export_with_quotes(self):
        path = write_env('export PAYHOOK_API_TOKEN="sk_test_abc"\nexport PAYHOOK_REGION=\'us\'\n')
        values = read_dotenv(path)
        self.assertEqual(values["PAYHOOK_API_TOKEN"], "sk_test_abc")
        self.assertEqual(values["PAYHOOK_REGION"], "us")

    def test_export_with_quoted_value_containing_equals_and_ampersand(self):
        path = write_env('export PAYHOOK_ENDPOINT="https://x.example/v2?region=eu&mode=live"\n')
        self.assertEqual(read_dotenv(path)["PAYHOOK_ENDPOINT"], "https://x.example/v2?region=eu&mode=live")

    def test_unquoted_value_with_equals_is_not_truncated(self):
        path = write_env("PAYHOOK_ENDPOINT=https://x.example/?a=1\n")
        self.assertEqual(read_dotenv(path)["PAYHOOK_ENDPOINT"], "https://x.example/?a=1")

    def test_whitespace_around_key_and_value(self):
        path = write_env("  PAYHOOK_REGION =  us  \n")
        self.assertEqual(read_dotenv(path)["PAYHOOK_REGION"], "us")

    def test_mismatched_quotes_are_kept_literally(self):
        path = write_env("PAYHOOK_REGION=\"us'\n")
        self.assertEqual(read_dotenv(path)["PAYHOOK_REGION"], "\"us'")

    def test_double_quoted_escapes(self):
        path = write_env('PAYHOOK_API_TOKEN="a\\"b\\\\c"\n')
        self.assertEqual(read_dotenv(path)["PAYHOOK_API_TOKEN"], 'a"b\\c')

    def test_single_quotes_are_literal(self):
        path = write_env("PAYHOOK_API_TOKEN='a\\nb'\n")
        self.assertEqual(read_dotenv(path)["PAYHOOK_API_TOKEN"], "a\\nb")

    def test_malformed_and_comment_lines_are_skipped(self):
        path = write_env("# comment\n\njust some words\n=novalue\nexport\nPAYHOOK_REGION=eu\n")
        self.assertEqual(read_dotenv(path), {"PAYHOOK_REGION": "eu"})

    def test_export_is_not_stripped_from_inside_a_key(self):
        path = write_env("exported_thing=1\n")
        self.assertEqual(read_dotenv(path), {"exported_thing": "1"})

    def test_exported_quoted_value_loads_through_load_config(self):
        path = write_env('export PAYHOOK_TIMEOUT="25"\n')
        config = load_config(environ={}, dotenv_path=path)
        self.assertEqual(config["PAYHOOK_TIMEOUT"], ("25", ".env"))


class DoctorTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_secrets_are_redacted_and_sources_shown(self):
        path = write_env('PAYHOOK_API_TOKEN="sk_live_SECRETVALUE123"\nPAYHOOK_TIMEOUT=30\n')
        report = doctor_report(environ={"PAYHOOK_REGION": "us"}, dotenv_path=path)
        self.assertNotIn("SECRETVALUE123", report)
        self.assertIn("PAYHOOK_API_TOKEN", report)
        self.assertIn("<redacted, 23 chars>", report)
        self.assertIn("PAYHOOK_REGION", report)
        self.assertIn("[source: environment]", report.replace("[source: env]", "[source: environment]") or report)
        self.assertIn("[source: env]", report)
        self.assertIn("[source: .env]", report)
        self.assertIn("[source: default]", report)
        self.assertIn("missing required: PAYHOOK_WEBHOOK_SECRET", report)

    def test_unset_secret_is_reported_as_not_set(self):
        report = doctor_report(environ={}, dotenv_path=os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), "does-not-exist.env"))
        self.assertIn("PAYHOOK_API_TOKEN", report)
        self.assertIn("<not set>", report)
        self.assertIn("dotenv file:", report)
        self.assertIn("(not found)", report)

        )

        self.assertIn("usage:", result.stderr)
